citations.claim: E approach green at step 105, last green second before yellow
E approach yellow at step 106, first yellow second
E approach still yellow at step 107, second yellow second
E approach red at step 108, first violating step: yellow lasted only 2s instead of required 4s

counterfactual.change: Set actuated true->false; fixed-time cycle then runs full 4s yellow, so no violation.

explanation: With actuated=true EW green gaps out early once its queue empties (queues 0 at steps 105-106) while NS has demand. The controller enters EW yellow at step 106 but switches to all-red at step 108 after only ~2s, instead of holding yellow_seconds=4. Likely the actuated gap-out/recall timer overrides or shortens the yellow timer.
vision_note: At step 105 two approaches show green, and both switch to yellow at step 106. The yellow holds only through step 107 before all signals are red at step 108, cutting the yellow phase short.
